scripts.dev: bun run --filter @adoptierlieber/api dev & bun run --filter @adoptierlieber/web dev & wait
scripts.deploy: bun run --filter @adoptierlieber/api deploy && bun run --filter @adoptierlieber/web deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run --filter @adoptierlieber/api deploy:staging && bun run --filter @adoptierlieber/web deploy:staging
scripts.check: bun run --filter @adoptierlieber/api check && bun run --filter @adoptierlieber/web check
